notes.high_cutoff: Keep the small prespecified rhythm panel; CV screening is unsuitable for centered mixed-unit features.
notes.cutree_cutoff: Upstream starting setting, not a validated optimum for rhythm data. Do not tune using held-out outcomes.
notes.module_bounds: At least two internal features and at least one external feature; DNBr takes exclusive bounds.
notes.ntop: Retain up to five ranks per development stage, matching the prior candidate-count budget; not five validated biomarkers.
notes.size_effect: Keep DNBr's default sqrt(module_size) multiplier. This is feature count, not participant count.
notes.force_allgene: Keep the same prespecified feature universe at every stage.
notes.selection: Call upstream clustering and ranking directly. Historical bootstrap/max-statistic gates remain only in the preserved old experiment.
